issues.title: HUMAN GATE · Fold Weave MIRROR ↔ CREASE only
issues.body:
Core implementation is complete on master. Do not reopen the Fold/Lens architecture from this issue.

- Ecology 0.2 and Two Dial remain distinct reachable branches.

- **Lens task-advantage gate is resolved:** direct PLAIN ↔ FOVEATED use showed no clear/notable gain; PLAIN remains default and FOVEATE is parked.

Only one human question remains:

### Fold Weave comparative play
- play MIRROR and CREASE directly;
- decide only from felt/useful difference whether CREASE deserves a default/promotion;
- either outcome is valid.

Do not:
- merge Two Dial into Ecology;
- rebuild Scale Lens;
- invent another Focus Ring/Lens state;
- reopen FOVEATE merely to seek significance;
- promote CREASE from code elegance alone.

Close after the MIRROR ↔ CREASE human receipt, even if the result is “MIRROR is better / no meaningful difference.”

issues.title: Print 01 · Digital → stencil/proof → physical → RETURN
issues.body:
## Goal
Reify the print/proof mechanisms already present in Cassette Atlas / House OS materials.

## Loop
canonical object/state
→ SVG/PDF plate
→ print/sticker/stencil/template
→ physical placement/use
→ photo/measurement/observation
→ RETURN receipt

## Candidate first fixture
One address strip / route tile / tool label / stencil with:
- stable ID
- scale
- registration
- revision
- source pointer
- manual fallback

## Done when
The physical artifact can be traced back to exact digital source and the observed physical consequence returns to the ledger.

issues.title: Recovery HOLD · Naming / glyph / Game-of-Names lineage
issues.body:
## State
HOLD / RECOVER-WHEN-PAYOFF. This is deliberately not a fourth live front.

## Goal
Locate exact artifacts/notes around naming systems, Game of Names, glyph/seal protocols, semantic identity and related experiments; preserve lineage and identify mechanisms that belong in current language/address tooling.

## Questions
- Which artifacts are exact runnable/source specimens?
- Which naming operations preserve referent/identity across transforms?
- What belongs with Verse/Path, what belongs with seals/glyphs, and what is a separate game/instrument?
- Which branches are merely aesthetic shells?

## Done when
A small lineage map and recovery entries exist; no new mega-app is invented.

issues.title: Census · Cluster Sep 05–19 Library artifacts
issues.body:
## Goal
Turn the recent Library/file explosion into a deduplicated recovery census.

## Method
1. inventory exact files and hashes
2. group exact duplicates
3. group near versions by lineage/name/content
4. classify HEAD / DONOR / RECOVER / QUARANTINE / SUPERSEDED
5. add only distinctive runnable/source artifacts to the migration ledger

## Priority clusters already visible
- Fold/Bloom / fold-weave
- AXIAL / state-transform
- ENV0 / House OS physical boards
- generated visual/reference batches
- Foundry / Grid Path / Verse Atlas
- Sleeper checkpoints

## Receipt
A machine-readable census plus counts by class; no source deletion.

issues.title: Pipeline HOLD · Messaging/account cleanup + autoresponder substrate
issues.body:
## State
HOLD / research and inventory. Do not send, delete, archive, label or mutate accounts from this task.

## Goal
Map the eventual communication substrate across email and messengers as one policy-governed intent/event/RETURN system rather than one bot per channel.

Recover/define:
- account/channel identities
- person/resource policies
- read/remember/acknowledge/draft/act/escalate gates
- thread/message canonical IDs
- drafts vs sent actions
- autoresponder templates/decision traces
- audit/RETURN

## Immediate output
Connector/tool availability map + read-only inventory plan + one bounded Gmail proof candidate.

No all-messenger automation until each channel has explicit authority and rollback semantics.

issues.title: Adapter HOLD · Body / health / anatomy state projection
issues.body:
## State
HOLD / adapter research only. Do not make this a live front.

## Goal
Recover the transferable structure used in health/body/case consolidation without importing private medical content.

Candidate canonical concepts:
- anatomical address / region
- observation vs interpretation
- event / intervention
- evidence confidence
- chronology
- state delta
- residue / unresolved
- RETURN

## Safety
Observation != diagnosis. Confidence/source must remain explicit.

## Done when
A privacy-safe Domain Pack/schema exists and can project into plain chronology, body map, training view, and printable reference without changing canonical identity.

issues.title: Reality 01 · One physical before→change→after RETURN
issues.body:
## Goal
Keep the abstraction stack reality-gated by completing one bounded physical/home transformation.

## Contract
Pick one zone or owned endpoint → record before-state → make one reversible change → record after-state → state what became easier/measurably different.

## Bounds
No new hardware purchase required. No expansion into a full House OS architecture.

## Receipt
Before/after evidence + one paragraph/JSON record of the state delta.
